title: Suspect of Sexual Harassment Arrested After Fleeing Attempt on Flight
subtitle: The arrest took place on Sunday morning after the victim reported the crime during Fest Lavras
excerpt: A man suspected of sexually harassing a 14‑year‑old girl at a Fest Lavras concert was detained in Juazeiro do Norte before boarding a flight to Fortaleza, after police.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
A man suspected of sexually harassing a 14‑year‑old girl during Fest Lavras, in Lavras da Mangabeira (CE), was arrested on Sunday morning before he could board a flight. The Military Police action, triggered by the victim’s family, stopped the suspect’s escape to Fortaleza.

What Happened on the Fest Lavras Stage

Around 2:40 a.m. on Sunday, the teenager, who was watching singer Natanzinho Lima’s performance, was approached by a man who ran his hand under her dress, touching intimate parts without consent. The young woman confronted the assailant, asked for help from the security staff—who did not intervene—and called her parents.

How the Suspect Attempted to Escape

After the incident, the man left Lavras da Mangabeira and headed to Juazeiro do Norte, where he intended to board a flight to Fortaleza. The teenager’s parents, upon learning of the escape, went to Juazeiro do Norte and requested assistance from the Military Police.

Detention in the Airport Neighborhood

Around 4:30 a.m., police identified the suspect in the Aeroporto neighborhood of Juazeiro do Norte and detained him. The man was taken to the city’s Women’s Defense Police Station (DDM), where police procedures were carried out. No information about a custody hearing has been released so far.

Identification of the Suspect

One source indicates that the suspect is businessman Miguel Carvalho Neto, a native of Fortaleza, who reportedly accompanied the singer at the event and flew on the artist’s plane. The full name was not disclosed in all versions, but the identity was mentioned as part of the investigation.

Repercussions and Next Steps

The victim underwent examinations at the Juazeiro do Norte DDM and gave testimony. The teenager’s father said he hopes justice will move forward and stressed the importance of talking to children about reporting harassment. Until publication, the suspect’s defense has not commented.

With information from G1, CN7.
